name: record_investment_recommendation
description: Record the final BUY / NEGOTIATE / REJECT call for this residential property, with the evidence that drove it.

confidence_percent.description: How confident the call is, lowered in proportion to whatever evidence was missing.

key_strengths.description: Short points in the property's favour.

key_concerns.description: Short points against it. Name any evidence gaps here.

recommended_offer_price_inr.description: Offer to counter with, in INR. Omit unless an asking price was supplied.
